agent.summary:
Fixed class mark collection so test classes inheriting from multiple marked bases receive marks from every base. Mark storage now keeps each class’s own marks separate, preventing inherited marks from being duplicated. Added regression tests and documentation.

`testing/test_mark.py`: 90 passed, 1 xfailed.
